title: 第9章 机会还是陷阱第10章 当猎户我也要当最好的
content_zh:
苏牧走进一间十分不起眼的破旧矮房之内，小心地闭上门户。
从张冲身上得到了十两的巨款，这是平民之家几年都攒不到的巨款。
一开始苏牧还担心事发，没敢动用这笔银子。
过了三四天之后，他发现张冲三人的死没有引起任何波澜，连柴帮都没有什么动作，他也就放下心来。
十两银子用来买房子自然不够，不过租下一间民房还是绰绰有余的。
原来和流民乞丐挤在破庙或祠堂内是没有办法，现在他有了户籍，手里也有银子，自然要先改善一下住宿条件。
眼下这个破旧的小院，便是他用每年二两银子的租金租下来的。
院子虽然有些逼仄，而且只有两个房间，但毕竟是独门独院，比之前已经是天壤之别。
倒不是苏牧租不起更好的院子，只不过他手里的银子有限，而且不宜太过高调。
将今日赚到的十七文放到床底的陶罐内，苏牧一边啃着买来的肉包子，一边唤出了面板。
【姓名：苏牧】
【身份：猎户（白身）】
【点数：26】
【武艺：伏波刀法（入门）】
“职业同样是猎户，我还是流民的时候，三天才会增加一个点数，现在我成了白身之后，一天就能增加一个点数。
这是户籍歧视啊。”
苏牧心中忍不住吐槽。
吐槽归吐槽，每天看着点数不断增长，他心中就充满了希望。
只需要一百个点数，他的伏波刀法就能提升到小成的境界了。
而这，现在只需要短短一百天时间！

“这些日子我从来没有间断过练刀，只是几乎感受不到进展，看来我练武的资质，只能算是普通。”
苏牧心中暗自道，“要想快速变强，还是得提高身份才行。”
苏牧正想着，忽然敲门声响起。
他把柴刀插在腰带上，谨慎地凑到门后，并未开门。
“谁？”
“牧哥，是我，刘枫。”
门外传来一个年轻的声音。
苏牧松了口气，拉开门，把门外一个十来岁的年轻人请了进来。
“你怎么来了？找我有事？”
苏牧有些疑惑地问道。
刘枫是他的房东，准确地说，刘枫他爹妈是房东。
刘枫他爹是南城区一间酒楼里的厨子，是苏牧售卖猎物的时候认识的，后来又凑巧租赁了他家的院子。
一来二去，双方也就熟识起来。
这刘枫是刘家的独子，有一次知道苏牧的身份之后，就非缠着苏牧带他出城打猎。
content_en:
Su Mu walked into a very inconspicuous shabby low house and carefully closed the door.
He got a huge sum of ten taels from Zhang Chong, which was a huge amount of money that ordinary people could not save in several years.
At first, Su Mu was worried about what would happen and did not dare to use the money.
After three or four days, he found that the deaths of Zhang Chong and the others did not cause any disturbance, and even the Chai Gang did not take any action, so he felt relieved.
Ten taels of silver is naturally not enough to buy a house, but it is more than enough to rent a private house.
It used to be that there was no way to live in a ruined temple or ancestral hall with the homeless and beggars. Now that he had a household registration and money in his hands, he naturally had to improve his accommodation conditions first.
The dilapidated courtyard now was rented by him with a rent of twenty taels of silver per year.
Although the courtyard is a bit cramped and there are only two rooms, it is a private courtyard after all, which is completely different from before.
It's not that Su Mu can't afford to rent a better yard, but the money he has is limited and he shouldn't be too high-profile.
Su Mu put the seventeen cents he earned today into the clay pot under the bed, and while gnawing on the meat buns he bought, he called out the panel.
[Name: Su Mu]
[Identity: Orion (white body)]
[Points: 26]
[Martial Arts: Fubo Sword Technique (Introduction)]
"My profession is also that of an Orion. When I was a refugee, it would take three days for my points to increase. Now that I have become a white body, I can increase my points for one day.
This is household registration discrimination. "
Su Mu couldn't help but complain in his heart.
Complaints are complaints. Seeing the points growing every day, he was filled with hope.
With only a hundred points, his Fu Bo Sword Technique can be upgraded to the level of Xiao Cheng.
And this now only takes a short one hundred days!
"I have never stopped practicing swordsmanship these days, but I can hardly feel the progress. It seems that my martial arts qualifications can only be regarded as ordinary."
Su Mu thought to himself, "If you want to become stronger quickly, you still have to improve your status."
Su Mu was thinking when suddenly there was a knock on the door.
He put the hatchet in his belt and cautiously moved behind the door without opening the door.
"Who?"
"Brother Mu, it's me, Liu Feng."
A young voice came from outside the door.
Su Mu breathed a sigh of relief, opened the door, and invited a teenage boy outside.
"Why are you here? Do you have something to do with me?"
Su Mu asked with some confusion.
Liu Feng is his landlord. To be precise, Liu Feng's parents are the landlord.
Liu Feng's father was a cook in a restaurant in Nancheng District. He met Su Mu when he was selling prey, and later happened to rent his yard.
After going back and forth, the two parties became familiar with each other.
Liu Feng was the only son of the Liu family. Once he learned about Su Mu's identity, he pestered Su Mu to take him out of the city to hunt.
